items.h: OTECH Colorful Labels for Cable Tags
Dimension: Sheet Size: A4 Paper, 210mm x 297mm (Tags 30pcs/sheet)

tabs.title: Description
tabs.html:
The OTECH Wire Tags Labels Sticker PVC Self Adhesive A4 Light Green is a high-quality and practical solution for cable and wire identification. Its fresh light green color ensures clear visibility and helps organize complex wiring systems efficiently in networking, electrical, and industrial environments.


Each A4 sheet (210x297mm) contains 30 pre-cut tags, allowing quick and easy labeling of multiple cables. Made from premium-grade PVC material, these labels are built to last—offering resistance to water, oil, tearing, and heat. This makes them ideal for both indoor and outdoor applications.


With a strong self-adhesive backing, the labels stay firmly attached to cables without peeling over time. They are compatible with inkjet and laser printers and can also be written on with a marker or pen, giving flexibility for different labeling needs.


Key Features


  • Premium PVC self-adhesive wire tags
  • A4 size (210x297mm) sheet
  • 30 tags per sheet (approx. 26mm × 84mm each)
  • Light green color for easy cable identification
  • Waterproof, oil-proof, heat-resistant & tear-resistant
  • Strong adhesive for long-lasting performance
  • Supports inkjet & laser printing
  • Writable with marker or pen
